notes.title: Swing Into Zero-G | Feature Update #1
notes.content:
🎉 New Game Mode: Local Multiplayer is Here! 🕹️

We’re excited to introduce Local Multiplayer, a brand-new game mode that lets you compete against your friends, family, or anyone in the same room! Get ready to experience the fun and excitement of our game in a whole new way, together!
